description_en: Queries the default log field configuration of a user
description_zh: 查询用户默认日志字段配置
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-user-log-field-config --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUserLogFieldConfig

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The delivery type. Valid values:

sls: Simple Log Service
parameters.help_zh:
投递类型。取值：

sls： 阿里云日志服务
parameters.name: delivery_type

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

AddList.description_en: The list of log fields that are configured in addition to the default log fields, in the format of "a,b,c,..."
AddList.description_zh: 除默认日志字段外，额外配置的日志字段列表，使用"a,b,c,……"格式表示

ConfigStatus.description_en:
The status of the log field configuration. Valid values:
initial: The configuration is in the initialization state.
updating: The configuration is being updated.
failed_finished: The configuration failed.
success_finished: The configuration succeeded
ConfigStatus.description_zh:
日志字段配置状态。取值：
initial：表示配置处于初始化状态。
updating：表示配置更新中。
failed_finished：表示配置失败。
success_finished：表示配置成功

DelList.description_en: The list of log fields that are excluded from the default log fields, in the format of "a,b,c,..."
DelList.description_zh: 相对于默认日志字段，少配置的日志字段列表，使用"a,b,c,……"格式表示

DeliveryType.description_en:
The delivery type. Valid values:

sls: Simple Log Service
DeliveryType.description_zh:
投递类型。取值：

sls： 阿里云日志服务

ExtendConfig.description_en:
The extended configuration for log delivery. The value is a string converted from a JSON object constructed with a series of parameters.
For more information about the parameters, see the ExtendConfig parameter description in the [ModifyUserLogFieldConfig](~~ModifyUserLogFieldConfig~~) operation
ExtendConfig.description_zh:
日志投递扩展配置。以一系列参数构造的 JSON 格式转化成字符串。
详细参数信息，请参见[ModifyUserLogFieldConfig](~~ModifyUserLogFieldConfig~~)接口的日志投递扩展配置（ExtendConfig）参数描述

FieldList.description_en: The list of log fields to be delivered, in the format of "a,b,c,..."
FieldList.description_zh: 投递的日志字段列表，使用"a,b,c,……"格式表示

LogDeliveryStrategy.description_en:
The log delivery strategy. Multiple strategies are supported. The value is a string converted from a JSON array constructed with a series of parameters.

For more information about the parameters, see the LogDeliveryStrategy parameter description in the [ModifyUserLogFieldConfig](~~ModifyUserLogFieldConfig~~) operation
LogDeliveryStrategy.description_zh:
日志投递策略，支持多个策略。以一系列参数构造的 JSON 数组格式转化成字符串。

详细参数信息，请参见[ModifyUserLogFieldConfig](~~ModifyUserLogFieldConfig~~)接口的日志投递策略（LogDeliveryStrategy）参数描述
